_comment: Null planar-fault labels: every stack sequence has an empty defect set. Hypothesis: the planar fault does not deviate strongly from the matrix, so explicit defect markers are hard to define and is_defect/dist_to_defect should stay zero. Under that view, MAE/MSE should be comparatively low if the labels were previously adding noise. Composition-independent keys match A-B_<stack> folder suffixes.
_rationale: Assumes the planar defect is not deviating too much from the matrix, therefore defect labels are left empty for all stacks.
